about: What the launchers fire. HU and seconds.

columns.model: assets row: the TF2 projectile model
columns.motion: straight (no gravity) or ballistic (falls under gravityHU)
columns.collisionRadiusHU: sphere radius used to detect hits
columns.armTime: seconds before it can be detonated (0 = always)
columns.sticksToSurfaces: true: stops and sticks where it lands
columns.detonateOn: impact (explodes on first hit) or command (right click)
columns.lifetime: seconds before it removes itself (0 = never)
columns.spinDegPerSec: visual spin around its flight axis
columns.impactSound: assets row played when it lands without exploding, or none

rows.source: TF2 rockets fly straight with no gravity; 10 s cap is this mod's cleanup
